personality_one_liner: A vibrant, gamified learning experience that makes coding feel like play, rewarding consistency with satisfying, chunky tactile interactions.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components. Use chunky spacing to maintain the tactile feel.

do's: Use on sticky headers or streak widgets over scrollable content
dont's: Do not use on regular list rows or standard buttons

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A motivational dashboard focused on the daily streak, current learning progress, and discovering new skills.

states.empty: Playful illustration of a notebook with a CTA to start the first coding lesson.
states.error: Oops message with a friendly 'Try again' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with profile avatar and flame streak widget. Single column for 'Continue Learning' large hero card (width: 100% minus padding). Followed by 'Trending Skills' using a 2-column wrapping flex layout (`flexDirection: 'row'`, `flexWrap: 'wrap'`, `justifyContent: 'space-between'`, `gap: md`).

screens.name: Learn
screens.purpose: Course catalog where users browse categories and view course details/progress.

states.empty: No courses found illustration + 'Clear Filters' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal scrollable pill filter row at the top (glass background). Below, a vertical stack of full-width course cards (`surfaceSecondary` with `shadow 2`). Each card includes a circular progress indicator or progress bar.

screens.name: Challenges
screens.purpose: Gamified arena for daily coding challenges, difficulty selection, and leaderboards.
screens.layout: Top section: Large Daily Challenge hero card with a bright gradient or tinted background. Middle section: Difficulty selector (segmented controls). Bottom section: Leaderboard as a vertical list with `surfaceSecondary` rows. Top 3 ranks should have subtle brandSecondary/brandTertiary accents.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase user achievements, learning stats, and badges.

states.empty: N/A - Profile always has base stats.

screens.layout: Header: Large avatar with username. Below: A 2x2 grid of stat cards (Streak, XP, Courses, Rank) using `flexWrap: 'wrap'`. Below that: 'Badges' section in a 3-column grid (`justifyContent: 'flex-start'`, `gap: md`).

empty_state.alt: playful 3d illustration notebook for empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '4 Tactile / Playful' personality strictly. Ensure cards are chunky, have generous `md/lg` paddings, and utilize `sm` or `md` radii for a friendly look.

BANNED COLORS STRICTLY ENFORCED: Do NOT use any blues (no navy, sky blue, indigo) or purples anywhere in the app. Use the defined Mint Green (#04B077), Sunny Yellow (#FFC800), and Coral Pink (#FF5277).

Gamification UX: Give the daily streak high prominence (e.g., in a sticky header with a flame icon). Highlight leaderboard top ranks and completed progress rings with the brandSecondary color (Yellow) to celebrate achievement.
Use 'Fredoka' for all headings and 'Nunito' for body text. Do not exceed font weight 500.
Implement glassmorphism on the bottom tabs and any sticky headers (like the streak/avatar header) overriding scrolling content.
When placing text over the 'hero_coding' image card, always use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at >=70% opacity) behind the text to guarantee contrast.
